title: sorghum schottii
intro: Sorghum schottii, commonly known as desert broom grass, is a type of flowering plant in the sorghum family. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, where it grows in dry areas and arroyos. The health benefits of Sorghum schottii include its ability to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for managing diabetes and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties.
